name: AI Radio & DJ
author: Rainy
description: Seed-anchored AI radio (YouTube-style autoplay of new music) plus an AI DJ that talks between songs. Injects into the home chip bar, the song context menu and the full player.
changelog: Initial release — AI Radio (endless similar-new-music stream from a seed song), AI DJ (spoken interjections between tracks), injected into the normal interface.

actions.label: AI Radio
actions.description: Start an endless stream of similar music based on a song you pick.

actions.label: AI DJ
actions.description: The AI DJ talks between songs: intros, transitions and stops.

actions.label: For You
actions.description: AI-curated new music feed based on your listening history.
